notes: All 7 web searches ran this time (6 required plus 1 on Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act cosponsors); none were refused. The official-site search returned only the 23 June 2026 SBA AI bill release; the searches on superintelligence, extinction or existential risk, pause or slowdown, China agreement, and 'AI safety' returned nothing mentioning Finstad. The Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act search (House bill H.R. 10538, introduced 24 September 2026 by Rep. Casar) found no source listing Finstad as a sponsor or co-sponsor; congress.gov was not checked directly. No House letter about AI risk signed by him was found. From the earlier attempt: finstad.house.gov was opened directly (home page, press releases 7 Oct to 11 Nov 2026, and the site's own search for 'artificial intelligence', 'artificial', 'machine learning' and 'superintelligence'). Only the two Small Business Administration AI bill releases (20 May and 23 June 2026) mention AI; 'superintelligence' returned nothing. The 6 Oct 2026 Safeguarding Technology from CCP Influence Act release is about government purchases from Chinese-linked companies and does not mention AI. Quotes were copied from the downloaded page HTML (curly apostrophe as on the page). Rep. George Latimer, not Finstad, made the 'curiosity and apprehension about the future of AI' remark in the May release, so it was left out.
